Held at Wimbledon on February 18th, and this was styled a " B " team fixture but as included in the Thames Valley team were such runners as Les Field and Alec Olney, the field was really much stronger than usual.

This was held at Wimbledon on October 21st and as there was a field of 90 runners it was decided to score 44 a side. First man home over our usual five-mile course was Les Field, of T.V.H., and he was followed by a club-mate in K.
